_comment: The only ignore list for `pnpm scan` and the CI scan jobs. Every entry needs tool, id, targets, reason, owner and expires (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 190 days out). Targets: a repo name, or image:<backend|imaging|web|floor>. An expired entry fails the scan. After editing run: bash scripts/scan.sh sync (rewrites each repo's .github/trivyignore.yaml for CI). HIGH fix clock: 30 days from 2026-10-10.

ignores.reason: false positive: wave and review notes quote command lines that BLANK the AI and Stripe keys (`KEY= KEY2=`); no value is present (checked: no sk- string of 20+ characters in any history line of invai-docs except a quoted URL slug)

false positive in one historical commit: the first scan report quoted a command that blanks the AI keys (empty assignments, no value). Local history is not rewritten; the line is reworded in the next commit. Exact path + rule + commit + line

false positive in one historical commit: the QA report quoted a command that blanks the AI keys (empty assignments, no value). Reworded in docs f577d27. Exact path + rule + commit + line

ignores.line_regex: ^\n?- `service\.ts`: per-key rules extracted into `mayRead` \(safe key\s->\scompany/vendor -> kind\) and `signKey` \(HEAD \+ presign, SVG attachment\); `downloadUrl` now uses them, behavior and its tests unchanged\. New `downloadUrls`: unique keys, one vendor sheet query for the whole list \(`vendorReadableKeys`\), HEADs with concurrency 8, results mapped back in input order \(duplicates included\); null exactly where the single call is NOT_FOUND, other errors fail the call\.\n?$
ignores.reason: false positive (B-369): one bullet in the wave 37 T-37-5 report lists code identifiers and words (a rule chain written with arrows); the flagged span is two plain words joined by a slash, not a credential. Committed history cannot change. Exact path (history and working-tree forms) + rule + the whole line, anchored at both ends; any other line or file in that report is still scanned
